result.summary: The layout is mostly clean. The clipped carousel items and the card cut off at the bottom are expected behavior. One likely content defect stands out: the second 'Popular right now' card shows a '−100%' badge, which looks like a wrongly calculated or formatted promo value.

issues.description: The second restaurant card in 'Popular right now' shows a '−100%' discount badge. This reads as the whole order being free and looks like a calculation or formatting bug, such as a free-delivery promo rendered as a percentage or a missing discount value defaulting to 100%. The card above uses a clear '€0 delivery' label for comparison.
issues.suggestion: Check the promo badge logic and data. Show the intended label (e.g., '€0 delivery' or the actual discount percentage). Guard against invalid or missing values so a 100% discount never appears unless it is truly intended.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has a dark circular background that nearly blends into the dark image. It looks inconsistent with the clearly visible circle on the card below.
issues.suggestion: Use a semi-transparent background with more contrast, a subtle border, or a shadow so the favorite button looks the same and stays visible on every image.
